# Astradmit

> Astradmit offers personalized 1:1 mentoring for MBA and Master's applicants. Founded by Priyanka Khandelwal, who has spent over a decade helping applicants understand where they stand, choose the right programs and build stronger applications. We give honest feedback and structured guidance. We do not write application essays or guarantee admission outcomes.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.astradmit.com/): Overview of Astradmit and how it helps MBA and Master's applicants.
- [About Astradmit](https://www.astradmit.com/about.html): Meet the founder, Priyanka Khandelwal, and the thinking behind Astradmit.
- [How we help](https://www.astradmit.com/how-we-help.html): The four areas of mentoring, how the mentoring relationship works, engagement options, boundaries and FAQs.
- [Resources](https://www.astradmit.com/resources.html): Articles, videos and a free MBA and Master's application tracker.
- [Contact and free consultation](https://www.astradmit.com/contact.html): Book a free 15-minute call through the Calendly calendar or send an enquiry form.
- [Book a call on Calendly](https://calendly.com/astradmit-info)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.astradmit.com/privacy.html)
- [Service scope and disclaimer](https://www.astradmit.com/terms.html)

## Facts
- Founder: Priyanka Khandelwal
- Focus: MBA and Master's admissions mentoring (profile evaluation, planning, GMAT and GRE strategy, school selection, application and interview guidance)
- First call: free, 15 minutes
